# MR PORTER

Generated from [tokens.json](tokens.json) and [README.md](README.md) by the design-systems catalog tool. Do not edit this file: change the tokens through the package's builders, then run `make design-md` at the repository root.

It follows the DESIGN.md spec, version alpha. That format has no themes, no per-value provenance and only px, em and rem units, so this file holds the `core` theme alone with every alias resolved. [tokens.json](tokens.json) is the source of truth: it records where each value was read, and keeps the 15 tokens from these groups that DESIGN.md cannot hold (gradients, shadows, percentages, durations and other non-colour or non-px values).

## Overview

Good for: Public shop: public pages captured signed out. Signed-in screens were not captured..

Captured 2026-11-22, signed out (public pages only; login, signup, checkout, and subscribe were not followed). Themes: core.

MR PORTER is a public men's luxury shop. This package is a signed-out capture of [https://www.mrporter.com/en-sg/](https://www.mrporter.com/en-sg/) on 2026-11-22. Desktop width measured 1440 by 900, `devicePixelRatio` 1. The homepage, Clothing, one product, and About Us were photographed. Nothing was typed, submitted, or signed in.

## Do's and Don'ts

- Do take values from [tokens.json](tokens.json) when you need another theme, a value's source, or a token this file leaves out.
- Do read [README.md](README.md) before relying on a value; it says what is known to be wrong.
- Don't read colours off the screenshots; they are 256-colour PNGs.
- Don't copy the product's logo, icons, illustrations or brand colours into something that ships. Borrow structure and proportions.
- Don't edit this file; it is regenerated from the tokens.

### What to distrust (from README.md)

This is the signed-out Singapore store. Do not treat the live hero, a product price, or the promo line as stable chrome. Prices show pounds and an approximate Singapore dollar figure.

Georgia is the UI face. SackersGothicStd is the display face and was loaded. Neither file is in this package. The style guide falls back to Georgia.

The header wordmark is a festive GIF and is not in this package. [icon.png](icon.png) is the public favicon, padded to 128 px on white, not a crop of the header.

Phone width was not captured. Hover and focus were not measured. Department menus other than Clothing were read from the homepage DOM and were not hovered open. The footer was not photographed, because it contains a subscribe form.
